tickets.title: eduroam Wi-Fi drops continually in 3rd floor quiet zone
tickets.description: Access Point AP-North-3F appears to be failing DHCP leases or rejecting auth. 20+ study desks unable to connect.
tickets.rawStudentInput: Internet keeps disconnecting every minute on the 3rd floor library. None of our laptops can stay on eduroam.

aiAnalysis.conciseSummary: Repeated wireless disconnection and DHCP negotiation failures on Library 3F AP.

assignment.notes: Remote diagnostics performed on Cisco AP-302.

statusHistory.notes: Rebooted local PoE switch port and updated AP firmware.
AP rebooted and ping stability verified across all 24 connected clients.
